name: MAX7219
title: 8×8 LED matrix with MAX7219 driver (chainable)
notes: Needs 5 V; on a 3.3 V board the MAX7219 usually still accepts 3.3 V logic but is out of spec.
Chain modules DOUT→DIN and set MODULES to their count.
The popular LedControl library builds only for AVR boards (Uno, Nano, Mega); MD_MAX72XX builds for ESP32 too.
